cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll repair your kettle for a spoonful of yesterday. Put your payment on the bench.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I pay with the five minutes I wasted this morning?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll allow wasted time. Useful time would complicate the repair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: But this morning is today. Will you still take it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave it overnight. I set the credit terms here: you get the kettle tomorrow, when your five minutes have become yesterday. No spending them while they mature.
